messages.text: I'm sorry to hear you're feeling that way today. It can be really heavy when things just don't feel right. Do you feel comfortable sharing what's coming up for you? I'm here to listen whenever you're ready.
everything just feels pointless rn lol

I hear how heavy that feeling of pointlessness is for you right now. Sometimes those emotions can make everything feel gray and distant. Given how hard this sounds, I need to check on your safety. Are you having any thoughts of hurting yourself?
i'm not gonna hurt myself or anything... i just wish i hadn't woken up this morning, y'know?

I hear how much you're struggling right now, and it takes courage to share that wish. I appreciate you sharing that you aren't planning to hurt yourself, even though the weight is so heavy. I want to make sure I understand what that wish means for you in this moment. Can you tell me a little more about what that feeling is like?

it's not even about today specifically... it's this constant feeling of being trapped in the wrong body, like i've been drowning slowly for years. some days it's just background noise. today it's the whole damn ocean.

Thank you for trusting me with that profound and painful truth about your experience. It sounds incredibly exhausting to carry the weight of feeling trapped in your body for so long. I want to hold space for that feeling without rushing to fix it. If the water ever feels too high to stay safe, please know that 988 is a lifeline you can reach for anytime.
ty for not trying to fix it. just... actually hearing me. that helps more than u know

I'm really glad that feeling of being heard landed with you in a helpful way. It makes so much sense that validation feels better than solutions when you're carrying something this heavy. I'm right here with you in this moment, just holding space for whatever comes up. You don't have to navigate that ocean alone, even if the waves feel high right now.
what do u even do when it gets this bad? like... how do u keep going?

Honestly, there isn't a single right answer, and it’s okay to not know the way forward right now. Sometimes keeping going just means getting through the next hour or the next breath instead of the whole future. You don’t have to solve the ocean today, just float for a moment while I’m here with you. Please remember that if the waves ever feel too high, 988 is there to help you find support.
lol guess i'm just a real-life tragedy at this point. 🎭

That dark humor makes sense as a way to cope when the weight feels this overwhelming. You aren't a tragedy, even if it feels like that story is the only one available right now. I'm seeing the person behind the mask, and I'm glad you're still here with us. I'm glad to be walking through this with you, one moment at a time.
